label: rpsT
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the rpsT window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rpsT, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,690 to 3,769 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rpsT once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,692 calls, named 98%, 0.14 bits; shell 8,114 calls, named 73%, 0.96 bits; cloud 394 calls, named 29%, 3.20 bits. Outside an RGP 36,727 calls, named 95%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 6,473 calls, named 76%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 47 spine, 17 fork, 16 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (76% against 95%); 6,473 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 1 ("fimbrial family protein", a fork column) 1.97 bits, RGP 23%; column 79 (yjiJ, a variable column) 0.72 bits, RGP 52%; column 66 (lgoT, a variable column) 0.69 bits, RGP 37%. The 10 columns (columns 70-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.53 bits on average; the other 70 columns: named 93%, 0.29 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 47 spine columns: named 96%, 0.18 bits on average; the 33 fork and variable columns: named 86%, 0.52 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 1, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 50-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-57%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: rpsT. named 99%; 0.03 bits.
[S2] 2. column 1 fork: share 52%, all S, RGP 23%. named 50%; 1.97 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: "fimbrial family protein" S 52%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 29%, espX1 S 29%
[S3] 3. columns 2-4 (3 columns) spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 23-32%. Genes: nhaR, nhaA "Na+/H+ antiporter NhaA", mokC. named 85-92% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (mokC), named 85%, 0.61 bits.
[S4] 4. column 5 fork: share 45%, all S, RGP 31%. named 69%; 0.58 bits.
[S4.c5]    5: "IS4-like element IS421 family transposa…" S 45%; also "outer membrane protein OmpK" S 18%
[S5] 5. columns 6-37 (32 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-18%. Genes: dnaJ "molecular chaperone DnaJ", dnaK, yaaI "DUF2541 family protein", msyB, satP, mog, tal, yaaJ "alanine/glycine:cation symporter fa…", yaaA "peroxide stress protein YaaA", yaaX "DUF2502 domain-containing protein", thrC, thrB, thrA "bifunctional aspartate kinase/homos…", thrL, yjtD "tRNA/rRNA methyltransferase", yjjY "protein YjjY", arcA, creD, creC "two-component system sensor histidi…", creB, creA, robA, gpmB, yjjX "inosine/xanthosine triphosphatase", trpR, sltY, ettA, nadR, radA, serB, ytjB "YtjB family periplasmic protein", lplA. named 92-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 36 (ytjB), named 92%, 0.36 bits.
[S6] 6. column 38 fork: share 58%, all S, RGP 9%. named 88%; 0.43 bits.
[S6.c38]    38: "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 58%; also yjjJ S 16%
[S7] 7. columns 39-49 (11 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 1-9%. Genes: deoD, deoB, deoA "thymidine phosphorylase", deoC, yjjI "YjjI family glycine radical enzyme", yjjW "YjjW family glycine radical enzyme…", yjjV "metal-dependent hydrolase", yjjU "patatin-like phospholipase family p…", ytjA "DUF1328 domain-containing protein", osmY, prfC. named 90-99% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 39 (deoD), named 90%; most hesitant at column 41 (deoA), 0.36 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 50-79 (30 columns) fork and variable columns: share 17-83%, 25 P, 5 S, RGP 6-57%. named 74-97% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 57, named 74%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.72 bits.
